text:
Maria L: quick heads-up — rotating HF->S3 mirror creds tonight at 23:00 UTC. Planning to run a dry-sync then a full mirror. Need a quick sanity check: md5/etag handling for multipart objects, presign TTLs, and any registry path changes. cc @Ashok P @Oliver K :wave:

Ashok P: thanks — what bucket/prefix are we using for this round? I want to confirm the manifest location before rotation.

Maria L: bucket = redwood-models-prod, prefix = hf/mirrors/zeta-variants/2026-03-18-rotate. Manifest at hf/mirrors/manifests/zeta-variants.json.

Oliver K: fyi multipart uploads will make S3 ETag != md5 for parts > 5MB. If you rely on md5 field in our registry we need the manifest to store both 'md5' (if available) and 's3_etag' to be safe.

Maria L: good call. current manifest only has `checksum` field (string). I'll update to add `s3_etag` and `digest_type` to be explicit.

Ashok P: also double-check presign TTLs for streaming downloads. Our mirror presigns are 30m by default; for large downloads CI sometimes needs longer for slow nodes. Maybe 2h for the rotate window?

Devex: reminder — if presign TTL > 1h, we need a ticket for audit to justify. Not blocking but flagging.

Maria L: noted. I'll open a quick ticket after this thread. For the rotate itself: plan is dry-run at 22:30 UTC (list objects + compare checksums), then rotate creds at 23:00 and run full mirror at 23:15.

Ashok P: for the dry-run, can someone run this snippet and paste results?

Ashok P: ```bash
aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-models-prod --prefix hf/mirrors/zeta-variants/2026-03-18-rotate --query 'Contents[].{Key: Key, ETag: ETag, Size: Size}' --output json
```

Oliver K: also add `--page-size 1000` if the prefix is large. For checksum compare script, remember to treat ETag with quotes (S3 returns '"etag"'). Our script strips quotes and lowercases.

Maria L: quick question on CI: our ingest job that validates manifests currently checks `checksum == md5(file)` — will that fail for multipart objects?

Oliver K: yes. If object was uploaded multipart by the origin, `md5(file)` != ETag. Two options: (1) origin provides a separate md5 metadata at upload time and we store that in manifest; (2) use a server-side computed sha256 of the streamed content during ingest (slow). (1) is preferred if origin can produce it.

Maria L: origin is HF (huggingface). They don't always surface md5 for mirrors. Can we make our ingest accept `s3_etag` as primary if `digest_type` == "multipart"?

Devex: that approach is reasonable. We should add a small note to the manifest schema docs and to the ingest PR.

ci-bot: scheduled job created: `mirror-dryrun-1768881234` - runs at 22:30 UTC. Logs will post to #eng-ml.

Ashok P: on permissions — when we rotate creds we need to ensure the new IAM role has GetObject, ListBucket, HeadObject and s3:GetObjectVersion if we rely on versioning. Also need kms:Decrypt if customer-side KMS used.

Maria L: new IAM role policy draft: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetObject","s3:HeadObject"],
    "Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-models-prod","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-models-prod/*"]
  }]
}
```

Oliver K: add `s3:GetObjectVersion` and `kms:Decrypt` (conditionally). Also confirm bucket policy doesn't block presigned URLs from our IP ranges.

Maria L: will add and send to infra for review.

Ashok P: final check on router/serving: if we detect s3_etag-only for a model, we should record `checksum_source: "s3_etag"` in the model metadata so runtime knows not to rely on md5-based fast-compare.

Maria L: agreed. I'll update manifest + registry schema and ping again once PRs are open. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Devex: tagging docs owners @Devex — please add a short note in the model-sourcing runbook about the multipart/etag caveat.

Oliver K: I'll leave a small helper in repo: `scripts/etag_to_md5_hint.sh` that documents how to detect multipart uploads and where to store s3_etag. Will PR after rotate.

Maria L: great — closing the loop. If anything blocks tonight ping here and I'll delay.

Oliver K: LGTM.

Ashok P: ✅

ci-bot: mirror-dryrun-1768881234 completed (success). Output: 24 objects compared, 0 checksum mismatches. More logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/mirror-dryrun/1768881234

Maria L: awesome — proceeding with rotate at 23:00.
